stories.title: Nog geen aanwijzing voor opzet bij ontspoorde trein in noorden van Frankrijk

en.title: No indication of intentional derailment of train in northern France
en.summary: Investigators have found no evidence suggesting the train derailment in northern France was deliberately caused.

stories.title: Man overleden bij aanhouding door politie in Rotterdam

en.title: Man dies during police arrest in Rotterdam
en.summary: A man died while being arrested by police in Rotterdam.

stories.title: Gouden Leeuw voor Deens oorlogsdrama ‘Woman Unknown’ op Filmfestival Venetië

en.title: Golden Lion for Danish war drama 'Woman Unknown' at Venice Film Festival
en.summary: The Danish film Woman Unknown won the Golden Lion for best film at the 83rd Venice Film Festival. Mathilde Arcel received best actress and John Malkovich best actor awards, while an Israeli documentary about the Gaza war won the jury prize.

stories.title: Feministisch Deens oorlogsdrama Woman Unknown grote winnaar op filmfestival Venetië

en.title: Feminist Danish war drama Woman Unknown major winner at Venice film festival
en.summary: A feminist Danish war drama titled Woman Unknown achieved significant victories at the Venice film festival.

stories.title: Persoon overleden bij aanhouding door politie in Rotterdam

en.title: Person dies during police arrest in Rotterdam
en.summary: A man on a fatbike died in Rotterdam after police arrested him for failing to provide identification. He became unwell during arrest and resuscitation efforts were unsuccessful.

stories.title: Ajax wint na rust ruim bij Fortuna (1-5), Brandt scoort op fraaie wijze

en.title: Ajax wins decisively at Fortuna (1-5), Brandt scores beautifully
en.summary: Ajax defeated Fortuna with a convincing 1-5 victory. Brandt scored an impressive goal in the match.

stories.title: Ajax wint ruim bij Fortuna met hoofdrol voor Kehrer en prachtgoal Brandt

en.title: Ajax wins decisively at Fortuna with leading role for Kehrer and stunning goal by Brandt
en.summary: Ajax achieved a 1-5 away victory against Fortuna Sittard, with debutant Thilo Kehrer playing a key role and Julian Brandt scoring a spectacular goal.

stories.title: Britse partij Reform UK krijgt recorddonaties van in totaal 84 miljoen euro

en.title: British party Reform UK receives record donations totalling 84 million euros
en.summary: Reform UK received record donations of 72 million pounds, including 36 million pounds from billionaire Ben Delo and a matching amount from crypto investor Christopher Harborne.

stories.title: Cryptomiljardairs doneren elk recordbedrag van 36 miljoen pond aan Reform UK

en.title: Crypto billionaires each donate record amount of 36 million pounds to Reform UK
en.summary: Two cryptocurrency entrepreneurs have each donated 36 million pounds to Nigel Farage's Reform UK party. Combined, these donations exceed the total amount received by all other political parties in the previous year.

stories.title: As uitstrooien in de Efteling 'komt incidenteel voor', ook al mag het niet

en.title: Scattering ashes at Efteling 'occurs occasionally', although it is not permitted
en.summary: Scattering the ashes of a deceased family member or friend at Efteling theme park is not allowed, yet a park spokesperson states it happens occasionally. The park considers the practice inappropriate.

stories.title: Tienduizenden mensen bij klimaatmars Amsterdam: 'Wij drammen wél door, Rob'

en.title: Tens of thousands of people at climate march Amsterdam: 'We will persist, Rob'
en.summary: Over 40,000 people participated in a climate march in Amsterdam, according to organizers, significantly fewer than the 85,000 attendees at the 2023 edition. Police and municipal authorities did not provide attendance figures.

stories.title: Nigel Farage krijgt 84 miljoen van cryptomiljardairs, een recorddonatie die zijn jonge Reform UK een ‘eerlijke kans’ moet geven

en.title: Nigel Farage receives 84 million from crypto billionaires, a record donation meant to give his young Reform UK a 'fair chance'
en.summary: Cryptocurrency billionaires have donated 84 million pounds to Reform UK, a record contribution intended to provide the nascent party with competitive resources.
